subject: Creating an on off switch for a variable in a data frame

messages.author: e9420bdfb914d34d
messages.subject: Creating an on off switch for a variable in a data frame
parts:
Hello, 

I would like to be able to create a UI that allows people to turn on and off a variable in a data frame.

However, upon the completion of the code block within the observeEvent related to my on/off button the relevant data frame resets to its original setting. 

Below is an example App which shows the problem I am having :

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  #inputs
  selectInput("name","which one to turn on or off",c("One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five")),
  actionButton("act","On Off Switch"),
  actionButton("test","TEST if change lasted"),
  
  #outputs
  tableOutput("out")
)# end ui

server <- function(input,output){
  observeEvent(input$act,{
    index<- reactiveVal(exampleDF$id[exampleDF$name == input$name])
    exampleDF$onOff[index()] <-switch(exampleDF$onOff[index()]+1,1,0)
    print(exampleDF)
  }) #end observe event
  
  observeEvent(input$test,{
    print(exampleDF)
  }) # end observe event
  
  output$out <- renderTable(exampleDF)
} #end server

shinyApp(ui = ui , server = server)
